customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
**A guess, and the sharpest one on this screen.** You told me risk and conviction are two different numbers computed on two different paths that only meet at the aggregator.

If that is true of the pipeline, a two-axis plot is the honest picture of it: names that are high-conviction and low-risk are the interesting quadrant, and crowding would show up as a cluster.

If the real dashboard shows one blended score instead, then the screen has flattened a distinction the pipeline maintains — which is exactly the kind of drift you said you couldn't locate.
